description: Returns the link where the person reviews and pays. Shop items: items[] with product id/sku, quantity and option text -> a formada3d.com cart link (pre-filled, live prices, Stripe checkout). Print quote: quote_id -> the quote page with that quote loaded. Design-studio items have their own studio links. This tool makes no payment and handles no card details.

variant.description: Option text, e.g. "Matte Black / Right Pull"
